clauses.title: P1 — Emergency
clauses.text: Risk to life, building or security, or loss of more than 50% of cooling capacity to an occupied area during opening hours when ambient exceeds 40 °C. Response 1 hour; make safe / restore service 4 hours; permanent rectification 24 hours.

clauses.title: P2 — Urgent
clauses.text: Partial loss of a building service affecting users. Response 4 hours; rectification 48 hours.

clauses.title: P3 — Routine
clauses.text: Defect with no immediate impact on users. Response 24 hours; rectification 5 working days.

clauses.title: P4 — Planned
clauses.text: Planned and preventive work, executed as scheduled in the agreed PPM programme.

clauses.title: Repeat faults
clauses.text: Where the same fault recurs three or more times within 30 days, the Contractor shall submit a written root-cause analysis and corrective action plan within 5 working days of the third occurrence.

clauses.title: PPM programme
clauses.text: Air-cooled condenser coils shall be chemically cleaned quarterly. Any deferral of a PPM task requires the Authority's prior written approval.

clauses.title: Space conditions
clauses.text: Occupied spaces shall be maintained at 22.5–24.5 °C dry bulb and 40–60% relative humidity during opening hours.

clauses.title: Performance deductions
clauses.text: P1 response failure: AED 2,500 per instance. P2 response failure: AED 1,000 per instance. Monthly PPM compliance below 95%: 2% of the monthly fee (AED 7,000).

clauses.title: Completion verification
clauses.text: Corrective work is closed only after the Authority's FM team verifies completion against agreed criteria; payment certification follows verification.

clauses.title: Safety
clauses.text: Work on refrigerant circuits, electrical isolation and roof plant requires a permit-to-work, lock-out / tag-out and a competent person; chemical cleaning agents require COSHH assessment and PPE. Heat-stress controls apply when ambient exceeds 38 °C.
